notablePrerequisites: You do not control another Jellyfish or have a Jellyfish in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Man-o'-War by paying {2}{U}.
Volo triggers, creating a copy of the Man-o'-War spell.
The Man-o'-War copy enters, triggering itself.
Holding priority, activate Food Chain by exiling the Man-o'-War token, adding {U}{U}{U}{U} that can only be spent on creature spells.
Man-o'-War enters the battlefield, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.
